newsitem.title: USA: Tristar major shareholder sells 1 mln shrs.
newsitem.headline: Tristar major shareholder sells 1 mln shrs.

text.p: Tristar Corp said Friday that its major shareholder, the Core Sheth Families, has sold a one million-share block of its beneficial holdings of Tristar common stock.

Core Sheth Families said it sold the shares to a "strategic business associate in the Middle East" who has had a long-term relationship with Core Sheth and who will serve as a distributor for certain Tristar products, Tristar said.
The buyer's name was not disclosed.
Tristar said the block was sold for $4.75 per share, reflecting a discount because of the size of the sale and low trading volume.
On Friday Tristar was trading at 7-1/4, up 1/16. Its 52-week low is 6-1/4.
Before the sale, Core Sheth held nearly 14 million shares, or 84 percent of Tristar's 16.7 million outstanding shares, Tristar said.
